name: Data Preview Storage Tank
implementation_notes: Dual-mode component (list/detail driven by :id? route param), mirrors DataPreviewEffluentPlantView.vue's watch()-driven mode switch exactly

Detail mode renders the Storage Tank Detail grid read-only straight from stored columns (no recomputation, historical data), however many rows the record actually has, plus an empty-state message for zero rows
Checked By/Acknowledged By rendered read-only with no role restriction on viewing, consistent with Data Preview Effluent Plant and this screen's business spec

UNLIKE Data Preview Threshing/Effluent Plant: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section, per this station's explicit scope; all 17 non-time_slot detail columns (including the 1 enum status column) are rendered in the detail-row grid since there are no identifying/context columns to treat differently

REVISI (tech-spec v2, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak, kode tidak diubah): mode detail memasang RecordVerificationActions (station-type='storage-tank', local-table='storage_tank_record') yang memanggil PATCH /api/records/storage-tank/{server_id}/verification; backend RecordVerificationService::setVerification menerapkan peran + cakupan mill lalu assertPeriodOpenForWrite (EnforcesPeriodLock) atas `date` record sebelum menulis — periode stasiun tidak terbuka / tanggal di luar rentang → 422 PERIOD_CLOSED tanpa perubahan kolom; komponen menampilkan pesan server dan baris lokal tidak diperbarui (UPDATE lokal hanya setelah sukses); offline → pesan 'Butuh koneksi internet untuk verifikasi'. Tercakup oleh backend/tests/Feature/Api/RecordVerificationTest.php (blok 'kunci periode pada jalur verifikasi') dan backend/tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php; mobile/tests/recordVerification.spec.ts mencakup galat offline tetapi belum punya kasus PERIOD_CLOSED khusus.

REVISI v3 (2026-10-03, sinkronisasi catatan uji — kode tidak diubah): celah 'recordVerification.spec.ts belum punya kasus PERIOD_CLOSED khusus' pada catatan REVISI kunci periode di atas kini TERTUTUP — mobile/tests/recordVerification.spec.ts menambah 'shows the period-lock (422 PERIOD_CLOSED) message verbatim as an error and leaves the local row untouched' untuk komponen bersama RecordVerificationActions yang dipasang di mode detail layar ini: pesan server 422 PERIOD_CLOSED ditampilkan apa adanya sebagai galat dan baris lokal tidak di-UPDATE. Uji hijau.

REVISI 2026-10-03 (e2e): spec Playwright mobile/tests/e2e/data-preview-storage-tank.spec.ts ditulis (12 test) dan lulus dalam run penuh suite Playwright mobile (727 lulus / 0 gagal, 65 spec) — known issue 'spec e2e belum ada' ditutup.

REVISI (2026-10-04, audit-fix — sinkronisasi artefak, kode adalah acuan): DataPreviewStorageTankView.vue kini memanggil recordVerificationApi.pullVerificationStatus('storage-tank', 'storage_tank_record', userId) best-effort saat loadList() dan refreshVerificationInBackground() saat detail dibuka (memuat ulang via getDraftWithDetails bila status berubah) → GET /api/records/storage-tank/verification?ids[]=… (baru: RecordVerificationStatusController/Service, routes/api.php, operator boleh, cakupan mill). PATCH verifikasi kini memakai prefix /api dan isNetworkError() memakai flag `network: true` dari apiClient. SyncFailureHint.vue ('Gagal sinkron: <alasan>' dari kolom lokal sync_error, ditulis/dikosongkan syncService) dipasang di item list (compact) dan di atas detail. Field Tanggal detail kini FormField type=date dengan toDateInputValue (utils/localDate.ts), sebelumnya datetime-local. filter-row grid minmax(0,1fr) — tanpa geser horizontal di 390px. Uji: SyncFailureHint.spec.ts, syncService.sqljs.spec.ts (#6 pullVerificationStatus), recordVerification.spec.ts, e2e sync-and-verification.spec.ts (pola #2/#9/#6 di stasiun lain), backend MobileReadEndpointsTest.php.
